lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a staggered grid pattern posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of spot centroids to form a structural grid across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three longitudinal ridges visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity highlights above and low-intensity shadows below.

other_distinctive_markers: Single Echeneidae (remora) attached to the ventral-lateral surface posterior to the pectoral fin.
